Indian Railways Announces Changes to Train Services and Routes

Indian Railways has announced several changes to its train services, including the extension of operation periods for some special trains and the alteration of routes for others. These decisions aim to accommodate increasing passenger demand and improve connectivity. Specific changes include the Dadar-Bhusawal Khandesh Express running six days a week and the introduction of new stops for certain trains.
